1921.body:
The top prize count on "$500,000 HOLLYWOOD RICHES" has not moved since we started watching it. The game still has three of three top prizes unclaimed. Smaller prizes keep getting claimed as tickets sell. The same top prizes are now among fewer tickets.

Tomorrow's count on "$500,000 HOLLYWOOD RICHES" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
1921.headline: Good news: no big claims

1927.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "CASH SCRATCH FEVER", most are still unsold. The game is near the start of its run, with three of three top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Everything above about "CASH SCRATCH FEVER" comes from the Georgia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
1927.headline: How much has sold

1929.body:
